items.title: Nxera Pharma (TSE:4565) Stock Could Be 18% Overvalued On Licensing Deal
items.summary: Nxera Pharma has delivered a sharp share price run over the past year, which puts fresh attention on whether that move lines up with the cash the business is expected to generate. With a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) view available, the key issue is how the recent pricing reflects the value of those future cash flows. items.title: Can AbbVie (ABBV) Justify Its Valuation After Raised Guidance And Strong Results?
items.summary: AbbVie (ABBV) just raised its full year 2026 revenue guidance to about US$67.8b and lifted its dividend, after reporting third quarter sales of US$17.4b and net income of US$4.2b. Recent price action has been strong, with AbbVie’s share price delivering a 6.1% 1 month gain and a 17.3% 3 month share price return.
